info.title: altacli
info.description: CodeAlta CLI: the CodeAlta harness without a window, for scripts, CI jobs, containers and benchmarks. Run a prompt to its end with altacli run, with text or JSONL output and exit codes that tell how it ended.

commands.name: alta
commands.description: Run an alta command, as the agents do

options.name: --project
options.description: The FOLDER the command runs for (default: cwd)

options.name: --offline
options.description: Do not refresh the catalog of models.dev

options.name: --no-mcp
options.description: Start no MCP server (no mcp command)

options.name: --no-plugins
options.description: Start no plugin (no command of a plugin)

options.name: --no-skills
options.description: Offer no skill command

options.name: --quiet
options.description: No progress on stderr

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
Warnings and the log on stderr too
Storage (one of; the default is visible):
visible: the sessions of ~/.alta, shared with CodeAlta Desktop and TUI. A
session the run writes (new, resumed, or a sub-agent) gets a marker
(sessions/markers) that makes them list it, and a lease while it runs
(sessions/leases/<id>.lease): Desktop shows it "Running in altacli",
read-only. A session leased elsewhere is exit 5.
Every mode: a private database, no alta.lock, no project registered.
Written: sessions/ and logs/altacli.log of the state root; auth/ and
cache/ of the profile, by providers. config.toml is never written.
